description: Defines the class BuzzPostShareSearchFilterParams, a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering search parameters related to sharing posts in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin.

classes.name: BuzzPostShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO for specifying search filter parameters for shared posts in the Buzz plugin, including an optional post ID for filtering.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Retrieves the post ID used as a filter criterion, returns null if not set.

methods.name: setPostId
methods.description: Sets the post ID filter criterion.
